title: Withdrawn access takes the person out of every call and its media
spec: docs/CALLS.md 'Admission: removed means removed'. DeviceAuth::revoked (default false) says a session ended because the person's access was withdrawn; StoredDeviceAuth sets it when the T611j re-check refuses the person (a deny, or no confirmation past the grace) and ends the session. device_session::serve, when with_live_session ends the session and revoked() is true, calls DurableServer::drop_from_calls for the person before returning SessionEnded, so a MediaEvent::DropPerson for each open call they were in goes to the media server. An ordinary end (signing out, an expired certificate) does not. Test: Alice (bound to the provider) and Bob are in a call and admitted to the media core; the authorizer denies Alice at her next request: serving ends with SessionEnded, the room store has exactly DropPerson for Alice, she is out of the call and the media core drops her and keeps Bob; with an authorizer that allows, serving ends normally and nothing changes.
